purpose: Finding the record that is the holder's own card in a vault, by hard identity: the id derived for that vault, or the record the vault's profile pointer names.
namedChanges: **the host constant becomes a setting** (RuleGhsSettingUnit; the one change in what the code does): `SYSTEM_HOST_LABELS = new Set([...])` (lines 102-106, a constant evaluated when the module loads and holding the platform's own host labels) is not copied. The one use, `ownCard.ts` line 150 of the source, `SYSTEM_HOST_LABELS.has(hostParts[0]!.toLowerCase())`, is `systemHostLabels().has(hostParts[0]!.toLowerCase())`, read when the function runs. `systemHostLabels()` is in the new file `src/systemHostLabels.ts` and throws until `setSystemHostLabels` is called. The labels are not hosts (so `base-origin`'s `systemVaultHosts()`, which holds whole hosts, would answer something else); the setting is kept inside this unit and not added to `base-origin`;
the new import `./systemHostLabels` is the only import of the file (the source has none);
the header comment of the file is a new, shorter one, and comments that name a host, a person, an agent or a ticket are reworded; no code changed.
